title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Response Ordering Verification Architecture
design_summary: The existing adapter architecture dispatches each stream independently in DoqServer.HandleQueryStreamAsync, ensuring that a slow zone transfer on one stream does not block another stream's response. This slice adds a verification test proving out-of-order response delivery.
data_and_state_considerations: No new adapter state or code changes required.

supplemental_sections.heading: Existing Architecture
supplemental_sections.content: DoqServer spawns concurrent tasks per stream via HandleQueryStreamAsync. DoqClient.QueryAsync completes per-stream, so the second query's response is available as soon as the second server task runs and completes.
